question: Among the dated events in the timeline, list in time order the occasions on which a district or island part was separated from Stord or added to it.
why_needs_multiple: Four separate boundary-change events must be combined into one list.
criterion: A part of territory was separated from Stord or added to Stord (a municipal boundary change). The founding of the municipality is not a boundary change.
